He must develop truth-confrontation allowing avoided-facts to inform vision-refinement through honest-assessment rather than defensive-rejection, accepting that effective-journeys require reality-foundation despite comfort-loss. Consequence: truth-facing protocol established revealing that while some conflicts stem from misunderstanding requiring communication-work, others derive from authentic-incompatibility requiring transformation-work rather than simple-resolution, refining his cosmic-reconciliation-approach from naive-harmony to complex-integration. This creates necessity for bias-examination work in the next scene where surface-truth must reveal deeper-pattern.

Francisco discovers his reconciliation-vision contains bias-assumptions—believing faction-goodwill exists beneath conflict when evidence suggests some groups genuinely prefer-dominance over harmony, requiring belief-revision not just fact-gathering.
